title: Section 225.11 – Revise Section 225.11 to read as follows:
officialText:
225.11 Overhead Branch Circuits Attached to Buildings or Structures. Overhead branch circuits and feeders
attached to buildings or structures shall be installed in accordance with the requirements of 230.54.
Informational Note: Refer to Part II of Article 225 for underground installation.
